newsitem.title: USA: Flow International retains Dain Bosworth.
newsitem.headline: Flow International retains Dain Bosworth.

text.p: Flow International Corp said Thursday it has retained Dain Bosworth Incorporated to assist the company in valuing FLOW's Access and Services businesses and to develop a strategy to refocus the company's operations.

"We selected Dain Bosworth as our investment banker after an extensive interview process," said Ronald W. Tarrant, FLOW's chairman, president and chief executive officer. "Our decision was ultimately based on our long-term relationship with Dain Bosworth, which managed our private debt placement in 1995. With their solid understanding of FLOW's business, we believe Dain will require less time to analyze our divisions and we are confident they will develop sound strategic alternatives for FLOW."

On February 27, 1997 FLOW announced its plan to refocus on its core ultrahigh-pressure technology, the area where its growth is the strongest. FLOW also announced at that time it was in the process of interviewing investment bankers to assist the company in analyzing its strategic alternatives and executing the selected strategy.
